title: The global AI boom has thrust CPUs back into the spotlight as Nvidia, Qualcomm, MediaTek, and others challenge Intel and AMD in the AI data center CPU market (Nikkei Asia)
summary: Nikkei Asia: The global AI boom has thrust CPUs back into the spotlight as Nvidia, Qualcomm, MediaTek, and others challenge Intel and AMD in the AI data center CPU market — TAIPEI/PALO ALTO, California — The global AI boom is reshaping one of the semiconductor industry's most important battlegrounds: CPUs.
